messages:
deploy-bot: rolling deploy started for service=redwood-api image=redwood-api:v2.3.1 region=eu-west-1 fraction=10%
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: PD-98765 — High error rate (502) for redwood-api in eu-west-1. Severity: P1.
pd-bot: page fired to Anna (oncall) — incident id PD-98765. Escalation in 6m if unacked.
Anna (oncall): acked PD-98765 — looking now. Anyone on deploy? @Lee?
Lee (eng): I triggered the rollout, saw healthchecks pass initially. I'm on it. Can you paste the error profile?
Sam (sre): telemetry: 5m p50 latency +1200ms, p95 +2.1s, 502 rate ~3.8% of requests in eu-west-1, baseline 0.03%.
Maya (cs): hearing from two customers in EU about failing inference calls — one reported 502s starting ~3m ago. Customer IDs: cust-axiom, cust-nova (private dedicated).
Anna (oncall): note: traffic fraction was 10% — canary. Need quick decision: rollback or divert.
Lee (eng): looking at canary logs — upstream tokenizer service returning 500 on long prompts. Suspect new tokenizer lib in v2.3.1.
Sam (sre): correlating metrics: errors correlate with requests > 2048 tokens. Volume small but significant for those customers.
Lee (eng): stack trace snippet from canary pod:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/tokenizer/wrap.py", line 87, in tokenize
    return tokenizer.encode(text, max_length=4096)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/tokenizers/___init___.py", line 202, in encode
    raise TokenizerError("invalid input")
TokenizerError: invalid input
```
Anna (oncall): PD shows 1 customer hit with degraded UX (chat timeouts), others ok. We should minimize blast radius.
Maya (cs): cust-axiom SLA alarm — they're on a dedicated pool but routed through same stack for this release. They're asking for ETA.
Lee (eng): immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback to v2.3.0 (fast), 2) patch tokenizer lib and re-release (slow), 3) route long prompts to previous version (needs routing rule). Recommend rollback.
Sam (sre): +1 rollback. I'll prepare traffic diversion and suppress noisy alerts for canary fraction during rollback.
Anna (oncall): I'll update PD status (investigating -> mitigation).
Anna (oncall): pd-bot: PD-98765 status updated to "identifying cause" -> "mitigating"
Lee (eng): running rollback command now:
```sh
redwood deploy promote --service redwood-api --version v2.3.0 --region eu-west-1 --force
# or if orchestrator: kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api -n redwood-prod
```
deploy-bot: rollback started for service=redwood-api region=eu-west-1 target=v2.3.0
incident-bot: suppressing repeat alerts for redwood-api in eu-west-1 for 10m (to avoid noisy PD flaps).
Sam (sre): watching infra: starting to divert traffic back to v2.3.0, healthchecks green on previous pods.
Maya (cs): notifying cust-axiom that we're rolling back and ETA ~5-8m. Sending proactive ticket.
Anna (oncall): ack gap closed — PD-98765 remains acknowledged. Escalations paused.
Lee (eng): rollback completed on 60% of canary hosts, latency improving in logs.
Sam (sre): metrics update in 2m: p95 back to normal, 502 rate dropping to 0.05%.
Anna (oncall): PD-98765: mitigation in place — rolling back release. I will monitor for 30m then update PD to resolved if stable.
Maya (cs): customer update: cust-axiom reports service restored, cust-nova still confirming.
Lee (eng): follow-up: we'll add a quick validation for tokenizer edgecases before next rollout. Need to revert tokenizer bump in repo and add test for >2048 token prompts.
Sam (sre): action items: 1) add alert rule to break out long-prompt tokenizer errors, 2) make canary routing avoid dedicated-customer pools, 3) add automated smoke with long prompt test to deploy pipeline.
Anna (oncall): PD-98765 timeline: fired 4612345678, ack 4612345685 (Anna), rollback started 4612345702, mitigation effective 4612345760.
Anna (oncall): transitioning to postmortem thread. If anyone wants to join the immediate post-rollback sync, hop into #incidents-postmortem in 10m.
Lee (eng): reaction :thumbsup: thanks team.
Maya (cs): reaction :heart: updating customers and closing tickets once confirmed.
incident-bot: incident PD-98765 now marked "mitigated" — monitoring window open for 30m.
Anna (oncall): closing loop here — will file a short incident brief with impact (approx 3% of EU traffic, 2 customers affected, no data loss) and next steps.
Sam (sre): adding note: dedicated pools should be excluded from canary routing until we have stronger validation.
Anna (oncall): thx all — I'll hand off to Lee for root-cause and to Sam for SRE follow-ups.
Lee (eng): taking ownership of RCA and PR for tokenizer revert.
Maya (cs): I'll follow up on customer communications.
Anna (oncall): thread closed for live mitigation. Postmortem link will be posted in 24h. :white_check_mark:
